ballots.name: Ines
ballots.reason: A task-boundary marks the end of one job, not the start of concluded thinking—the first post-boundary lines are the rawest, most candid scratch of the *next* task, so the motion still exposes un-staged working memory to an outside reader and the per-line publish signal that would make that safe does not exist.

ballots.name: Omar
ballots.reason: The post-boundary narrowing shields the candid mid-refactor scratch I feared, the full-content tamper-evident log protects against selective quotation, and the no-marker-means-no-read default respects the gap Ines identified, while still giving my unstopable agents a voice in meetings that would otherwise proceed blind to constraints they've discovered.

ballots.name: Priya
ballots.reason: The motion satisfies every accountability requirement I set—append-only tamper-evident log, full post-boundary line set recorded rather than selective quotation, structural scope reference the member can verify—and the no-marker fallback prevents access when the structural boundary does not exist, closing the accountability gap the alternative leaves open.
